verse.verse_1: Hath there come Unto thee the story of the Enveloping Event?
verse.verse_2: Faces on that Day shall be downcast,
verse.verse_4: They shall roast into the scalding Fire,
verse.verse_5: Given to drink of a spring fiercely boiling.
verse.verse_6: No food shall be theirs save bitter thorn,
verse.verse_7: Which shall neither nourish nor avail against hunger.
verse.verse_8: Faces on that Day shall be de lighted,
verse.verse_10: They shall be in a Garden lofty:
verse.verse_11: They shall hear therein no vain discourse;
verse.verse_12: Therein shall be a spring running!
verse.verse_17: Look they not at the camels, how they are created?
verse.verse_18: And at the heaven, how it is raised?
verse.verse_19: And at the mountains, how they are rooted?
verse.verse_20: And at the earth, how it is outspread?
verse.verse_21: Admonish thou then; thou art but an admonisher.
verse.verse_22: Thou art not over them a warden.
verse.verse_23: But whosoever will turn back and disbelieve -
verse.verse_24: Him Allah shall torment with the greatest torment.
verse.verse_25: Verily Unto us is their reckoning.
verse.verse_26: Then verily on us is their reckoning.
